import sys
import math

def main():
    input_data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    n = int(input_data[0])
    k = int(input_data[1])
    v = [0] * 10
    for i in range(k):
        v[int(input_data[2 + i])] = 1
    comb = [1]
    powerCount = n // 2
    while powerCount > 0:
        if (powerCount & 1) == 1:
            comb = polynomial_multiply(comb, v, 998244353)
        v = polynomial_multiply(v, v, 998244353)
        powerCount >>= 1
    totalSum = 0
    for val in comb:
        totalSum = (totalSum + val * val) % 998244353
    print(totalSum)

def polynomial_multiply(p1, p2, mod):
    size = max(2, 1 << (len(p1) + len(p2) - 1).bit_length())
    aReal = [0.0] * size
    aImag = [0.0] * size
    for i in range(len(p1)):
        x = ((p1[i] % mod) + mod) % mod
        aReal[i] = x & ((1 << 15) - 1)
        aImag[i] = x >> 15
    fft_transform(aReal, aImag, False)
    bReal = [0.0] * size
    bImag = [0.0] * size
    if p1 is p2:
        bReal[:len(p1)] = aReal[:len(p1)]
        bImag[:len(p1)] = aImag[:len(p1)]
    else:
        for i in range(len(p2)):
            x = ((p2[i] % mod) + mod) % mod
            bReal[i] = x & ((1 << 15) - 1)
            bImag[i] = x >> 15
        fft_transform(bReal, bImag, False)
    faReal = [0.0] * size
    faImag = [0.0] * size
    fbReal = [0.0] * size
    fbImag = [0.0] * size
    cof = 0.25 / size
    for i in range(size):
        j = (size - i) & (size - 1)
        a1r = aReal[i] + aReal[j]
        a1i = aImag[i] - aImag[j]
        a2r = aImag[i] + aImag[j]
        a2i = aReal[j] - aReal[i]
        b1r = (bReal[i] + bReal[j]) * cof
        b1i = (bImag[i] - bImag[j]) * cof
        b2r = (bImag[i] + bImag[j]) * cof
        b2i = (bReal[j] - bReal[i]) * cof
        faReal[i] = a1r * b1r - a1i * b1i - a2r * b2i - a2i * b2r
        faImag[i] = a1r * b1i + a1i * b1r + a2r * b2r - a2i * b2i
        fbReal[i] = a1r * b2r - a1i * b2i + a2r * b1r - a2i * b1i
        fbImag[i] = a1r * b2i + a1i * b2r + a2r * b1i + a2i * b1r
    fft_transform(faReal, faImag, True)
    fft_transform(fbReal, fbImag, True)
    res = [0] * size
    for i in range(size):
        aa = round(faReal[i])
        bb = round(fbReal[i])
        cc = round(faImag[i])
        res[i] = (int)((aa + (bb % mod) << 15) + ((cc % mod) << 30)) % mod
    return res

def fft_transform(real, imag, invert):
    n = len(real)
    j = 0
    for i in range(1, n):
        bit = n >> 1
        while j & bit:
            j &= ~bit
            bit >>= 1
        j |= bit
        if i < j:
            real[i], real[j] = real[j], real[i]
            imag[i], imag[j] = imag[j], imag[i]
    len_ = 2
    while len_ <= n:
        angle = 2 * math.pi / len_ * (-1 if invert else 1)
        wlenCos = math.cos(angle)
        wlenSin = math.sin(angle)
        for i in range(0, n, len_):
            wCos = 1.0
            wSin = 0.0
            for j in range(i, i + len_ // 2):
                u = real[j]
                v = real[j + len_ // 2] * wCos + imag[j + len_ // 2] * wSin
                real[j] = u + v
                real[j + len_ // 2] = u - v
                tempW = wCos * wlenCos - wSin * wlenSin
                wSin = wSin * wlenCos + wCos * wlenSin
                wCos = tempW
        len_ <<= 1
    if invert:
        for i in range(n):
            real[i] /= n
            imag[i] /= n

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
